verdict.rationale: Kick documents an Activity tab described as a full audit trail of everything in the workspace. It logs every transaction change, categorization update and sync event with a timestamp and the name of the person or Kick agent responsible, and since all entities live in a single workspace this covers the ledger broadly. missing for 10: explicit evidence of before/after field values, explicit coverage of chart-of-accounts and manual journal-entry edits, cross-entity filtering/export of the log, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger

citations.quote: Every transaction change, categorization update, and sync event is logged with a timestamp and the name of whoever or whatever made the change
The Activity tab is a full audit trail of everything that's happened in your workspace.
Kick lets you manage all your entities from a single workspace.
